purpose: Non-mutating harness validation that frozen S2 recomputation is invariant to semantics-preserving row order, feature-column order, and canonical lossless serialization.

frozen_inputs.provided_inputs: Feature/strata paths and hashes frozen in config/shrink-h1b-rule-level-preregistered.json; official sample hashes frozen in config/shrink-s2-assumption-bound-preregistered.json. Read GEOID only from official samples.

transformations.row_order: Reverse official-row order independently for C2, gap estimates, feature summaries, and strata maps; recompute scores keyed by GEOID.
transformations.column_order: Reverse insertion order of every input record's named feature/component columns; estimator continues to access named fields.
transformations.stable_serialization: Canonical JSON sort_keys=true, compact separators, UTF-8, allow_nan=false; decode and recompute. This round-trips official input maps and IEEE-754 values losslessly.
